title: Box Shadow
definition: Utilities for applying drop shadows to elements, creating a sense of depth and elevation.
simpleExplanation: Floating boxes. `shadow-sm` makes it look like the card is resting flat on the table. `shadow-2xl` makes it look like the card is floating 6 inches above the page. Use shadows to make important elements (like modals and dropdowns) pop out.
realWorldExample: Adding `shadow-md` to a white card on a light gray background, allowing the user's brain to instantly distinguish the card from the background.

basic: What is the standard class to add a medium, modern drop shadow to a card?
intermediate: Can you change the color of a shadow in Tailwind?

answers.question: Change color?
answers.answer: Yes! You can use `shadow-blue-500/50` to create a glowing blue neon shadow instead of the default black/gray shadow.
